transcript: Bhai aao main dikhata hoon power of AI. Abhi ek app ne 40 lakh se zyada ka revenue kar liya maatra 30 dino mein aur directly tumhein screen pe dikhata hoon ye app kya hai. Toh app ka naam hai Nutria, ek AI calorie tracker. MRR dekho bhai $46,000 se bhi zyada, jiska matlab hota hai kareeban-kareeban 44 lakh rupees. Isme 14 hazar se bhi zyada active subscriptions hain. Aur dekho bhai company founded kab hui hai, July 2025 mein. Iski app pe aa gaya hoon aur isme directly likha hua hai ki tumhari calories us basis pe track hongi jo tum kha rahe ho. Isme apne saare workouts daal dena aur us basis pe tumhara ek chart ban ke aa jayega. Toh bhai kaafi simple problem solve kari hai is bande ne aur uske liye ek app bhi bana di aur isiliye 40 lakh se zyada ka revenue kar raha hai har month. Ab aise app tum bhi bana sakte ho, bas comment kar dena "APP", tumhein main woh saare apps bhej dunga jiski madad se aise apps bana sakte ho. Baaki milta hoon tumse next video mein, tab tak ke liye Jai Mata Di.
